name: Birch Sapling
source:
Welcome to Coffins, where the coffee is so good it's deadly!

Birch Sapling is a short visual novel about two friends meeting for the first time. 

[From [url=https://koimarina.itch.io/birch-sapling] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到“棺材”咖啡馆，这里的咖啡好喝到致命！《白桦幼苗》是一部短篇视觉小说，讲述两位朋友第一次见面的故事。

[来源：[url=https://koimarina.itch.io/birch-sapling]itch.io[/url]]
